A collection of examples and curious phenomena in non-reductive group actions and invariant theory.

The cages below are examples I have had lying around for a while. I write each one up in LaTeX, and an AI tool turns the file into a Quarto page and adds it to the zoo.

If you have an example that deserves to be housed here, please email me at bunnett at math.tu-berlin.de.
